title: Gazpacho with prawns and egg
steps: Roughly chop the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper and garlic and blend very smoothly with the bread, oil, vinegar and salt.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and chop them; cook the prawns in simmering water for 2–3 minutes.
Pour the gazpacho into bowls and serve with the prawns and egg.
